title: Property, Plant and Equipment
intro: الأصل الثابت يُسجل أولاً **بالتكلفة**: سعر الشراء + التكاليف المباشرة لتجهيزه + التقدير الأولي لتكاليف الإزالة.
بعد ذلك تختار **نموذج التكلفة** أو **نموذج إعادة التقييم** لكل فئة (class) بالكامل.
الإهلاك يبدأ لما الأصل يكون **جاهز للاستخدام**، وكل جزء جوهري له عمر مختلف يُهلك منفصلاً.

tf.s: Land and buildings are accounted for separately, even when acquired together.
tf.why: Land usually has an unlimited life; buildings are depreciated.
Land normally has an unlimited useful life (exceptions: quarries, landfill sites).

tf.s: Gains on derecognition of PPE are classified as revenue.
tf.why: Gains on disposal go to profit or loss but are not revenue.

tf.s: Depreciation stops when an asset becomes temporarily idle.
tf.why: Depreciation continues while idle, unless the asset is fully depreciated.

tf.s: Residual value and useful life are reviewed at least at each financial year-end.
tf.why: Changes are accounted for as changes in estimate (IAS 8).

tf.s: The revaluation surplus may be transferred directly to retained earnings when the asset is derecognised.
tf.why: The transfer is within equity, not through profit or loss.

fill.s: Depreciation begins when the asset is ___ for use.
A first-time revaluation increase is recognised in ___.
Each significant ___ of an item of PPE is depreciated separately.
A change in useful life is a change in accounting ___.

source: Written for IFRS Play from the standard's core requirements. Exact source reference could not be verified from the uploaded document.

je.s: A machine is bought for 200,000 cash. Installation costs of 10,000 are also paid in cash.
je.why: Installation is directly attributable, so it is part of cost.
Depreciation is an expense with a credit to accumulated depreciation.

je.s: Land carried at 500,000 is revalued to 650,000 for the first time.
je.why: A first upward revaluation goes to OCI and the revaluation surplus.

calc.s: Cost 120,000, residual value 20,000, useful life 5 years, straight line. Carrying amount at the end of year 2?
An asset with a carrying amount of 52,000 is sold for 45,000. What is the loss on disposal?

steps: Annual review of useful life and residual value
Derecognition on disposal: gain or loss to P&L

multi.s: Which are changes in accounting ESTIMATE (applied prospectively)? (select all)
opts: Correcting last year's depreciation calculation mistake
multi.why: Correcting a mistake is a prior period error, applied retrospectively.
